pages.text: Put TNT in the fuel slot. Each block supplies 200 FE/t for 1,200 ticks at base speed, for 240,000 FE overall. An attached receiver must draw energy to make room after the 100,000 FE buffer fills.

pages.title: Troubleshooting
pages.text: If the display shows zero while TNT is present, switch to Ignore or supply redstone in Signal mode. Make sure the adjacent machine accepts FE on the connected face.
